sentences.en: Many Algerian associations are only there to receive government subsidies.
sentences.zh: 很多阿尔及利亚的协会只是为了领取政府补助而存在的。

sentences.en: The country's agricultural base is largely dependent on government subsidies.
sentences.zh: 该国的农业基础很大程度上依赖于政府补助。

sentences.en: Subsidies are costing the Algerian government billions of dollars every year.
sentences.zh: 补贴每年让阿尔及利亚政府损失数十亿美元。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：sub（下面）+sid（坐）+y→在台下就座领津贴→津贴
